description_en: This monastic compound is a branch of the larger monastery Bu Bāhāḥ (LAL0440). It has a small shrine on its western side that faces east. This shrine takes the form of a one-storey temple based on a low stone plinth. The main deity has been placed on a raised plinth 90 cm above this base plinth. The plinth has anāgvaḥdesign (quarter round) profile at its base with a band ofkasimvaḥdecorative bricks above it. A line ofnāgabelīcan be found on the brick wall around the middle of the plinth. The edge of the plinth consists of a black stone above a layer of lotus leaf bricks that have eroded due to weather exposure. On top of this plinth is a small carved timber structure which opens up at three sides and with a rear brick wall.The sanctum has a unique pitched roof; its three tiers are plastered in lime, and the upper part has a bell-shaped design. Astūpaforms the pinnacle of the temple. In front of the temple structure and at the center of the courtyard, one can find avajradhātu caityabuilt on a square plan of 386 cm. A smalldharmadhātu maṇḍala(80 cm high) has been built between thecaityaand the temple structure. The square courtyard measures 13.3 m x 13.3 m and is surrounded by residential buildings in all directions, with a small open space at the south-east corner.Normally, one can see images of Mahākāla and Hanumān at the gate of mostbāhāḥs,however this is not the case here. There is also notoraṇaabove the main shrine's entrance.Locke(1985, 159) andVajrācārya(1993, 117) both mention that the main deity in the sanctum used to be a statue of Amitābha. However, this has been replaced by a stone statue of an eastern-facing Akṣobhya.No inscription or other document providing any further information about the establishment of the Bāhāḥ could be uncovered. Although he cannot find hard evidence to prove his theory,Pruscha(2015, 140) argues that this monument was constructed in the 16th century.The Bāhāḥwas built by Śreṣṭhas, and Vajrācāryas from Bu Bāhāḥ used to perform the ritual worship in the shrine. The Śreṣṭha representatives bestowed lands upon the shrine to fund aguṭhīfor its management (Vajrācārya1993, 117). Until the late 20th century, 5pāthīof unhusked rice was collected every year for the Bāhāḥ from the harvest. Today, the situation has changed; the Bāhāḥno longer receives income from the land and the daily ritual worship has come to an end.
description_ne: यो यशोधर महाविहार, बुबाहा: (LAL0440) शाखाविहार हो । प्यंग:थां टोलमा इकुबाहा: (LAL0470) छिर्ने गल्लीको ठीक सामुन्ने यो बाहा: अवस्थित छ । अरु बाहा:मा जस्तो यहाँ बाहा:भित्र प्रवेश गरेपछि ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ महाकाल, हनुमान राखिएका छैनन् । यो बाहा:मा कुनै द्य:छेँ छैन, पूर्वाभिमुख गरी सानो मन्दिर बनाइएको छ । अग्लो इँटाको पेटीमाथि दुई तहको प्लाष्टर गरिएको छाना राखी मन्दिर बनाइएको छ । मन्दिरको माथि घण्टाकार आकार बनाई गजूरको रूपमा चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिरको छाना अड्याउन स-साना सादा टुँडाल राखिएका छन् । गर्भगृहको ढोकामाथि कुनै तोरण राखिएको छैन । फलामको डण्डी राखी गर्भगृहको ढोका बनाइएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पहिले अमिताभ बुद्ध राखिएको थियो (Locke1985, 159;Vajrācārya1993, 117). तर अहिले ढुंगाको अक्षोभ्य बुद्धलाई क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । क्वा:पा:द्य:सँगै दक्षिणमा अर्को अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध राखिएको छ । बाहा: प्राङगनमा एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल र एउटा इँटाले बनाइएको वज्रधातु चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो बाहा: कहिले स्थापना गरियो भन्ने कुराको जानकारी दिने कुनै अभिलेख भेटिएको छैन ।Pruscha(2015, 140) ले ईशाको १६ औं शताब्दीतिर यो बाहा: निर्माण गरिएको भनेका छन् । यो शाक्य-वज्राचार्यहरूको बाहा: नभई श्रेष्ठहरूले बनाएको बाहा: हो । बुद्धधर्मप्रति श्रद्धा भएका श्रेष्ठहरूले यो बाहा: बनाएर बुबाहा:का वज्राचार्यहरूलाई पूजाआजा लगायतका धार्मिक-साँस्कृतिक गतिविधि गर्ने जिम्मा दिएका थिए । ती श्रेष्ठहरूले बाहा: सञ्चालन गर्नएक रोपनी जग्गा गुठी राखिदिएका थिए (Vajrācārya1993, 117) ।जग्गाको आयस्ता स्वरूप केही वर्षअघिसम्म ५ पाठी धान बाली आउँथ्यो (Locke1985, 159) । तर अहिले अवस्था बदलिएको छ । जग्गाबाट प्राप्त हुने आयस्ता नभएपछि नित्यपूजा समेत बन्द भइसकेको छ ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)

historical_events.event_name: The earliest mention of the Bāhāḥ
historical_events.event_description: Sijaḥ Bāhāḥ is mentioned in a land document as Sijabāhāra.
